title: SAES consolidated edge
description: One consolidated edge in the accumulated evidence base. Aggregates K extracted relationship rows that share the same (subject_code, object_code) edge, after vocabulary harmonisation. Mandatory provenance back to source row IDs.

edge_id.description: Stable identifier for this edge. Convention: subject_code + double underscore + object_code, e.g. 'gold_mining_artisanal__forest_cover_loss'.

subject_code.description: Canonical code for the subject of the edge. After vocabulary harmonisation if a mapping table was applied.

object_code.description: Canonical code for the object of the edge.

n_rows.description: Number of extracted rows aggregated into this edge.

valence_distribution.description: Tally of rel_valence values across contributing rows.

modal_valence.description: The most common valence if it accounts for >50% of rows; otherwise 'mixed'.

stratification.description: Within-edge breakdowns. Each sub-object reports the row count and valence distribution per stratum.

by_causal_inference_level.description: Keyed by causal_inference_level value (Association / Controlled comparison / Intervention / Counterfactual).

disagreement_flag.description: True if the edge contains a valence conflict, existence conflict, magnitude conflict, or direction conflict (as defined in 02_disagreement_surfacing.md). When true, the edge is referenced from disagreement_report.md.

effect_size_summary_within_stratum.description: Optional. Within-stratum effect-size summaries. Only populated for strata that meet the pooling policy declared in 01_consolidation.md (same metric, numeric magnitudes, >=3 rows). Never pool across strata.

stratum.description: Free-text description of the stratum, e.g. 'method_type=Statistical modelling; causal_inference_level=Association'.

note.description: Must include the phrase 'Within-stratum pooling; not an overall effect.' so readers cannot accidentally misread as a meta-analytic estimate.

provenance_row_ids.description: Mandatory. List of row IDs (or paper_id + row_index_within_paper) that contribute to this edge. The chain of custody back to source verbatim text.

top_contributing_paper.description: Optional. paper_id of the paper contributing the largest number of rows on this edge.

date_range_of_papers.description: Optional. Year range of contributing papers, e.g. '2001–2022'.
